name: KnowDeck
title_zh: 单文件跑起来的个人博客加知识库
tagline_zh: 受够了 WordPress 插件地狱和 Hexo 每次换机重配环境？Go 编译出单个可执行文件。
tagline_en: Tired of WordPress plugin hell or rebuilding Hexo on every new machine? One Go binary, SQLite for content, React.
desc_en: 轻量级个人博客与知识库系统，基于 Go、React、SQLite 与 Docker Compose。
why_zh: 后端编译成单文件、无运行时依赖，正文全在 SQLite 里，备份就是拷一个文件。前后端同仓。
why_en: Backend compiles to one dependency-free binary; all content lives in a single SQLite file you can just copy to back up. Frontend.
limit_zh: 只适合单人或小团队自用：没有多租户、没有细粒度权限和审核流，也没有全文检索插件生态。要 CDN、评论审核。
limit_en: Single-user or small-team only: no multi-tenancy, no fine-grained roles or moderation, no plugin ecosystem. You build it yourself with Go and Docker.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。

title_en: A personal blog and knowledge base in one Go binary
